description: This file implements text-to-speech conversion using external APIs (OpenAI and ElevenLabs), including stream processing with rate limiting, and provides functions to get available voices for each provider.

methods.name: convertTextToSpeechStream
methods.description: Converts text to speech stream using specified provider, handles stream processing, rate limiting, and abort signals.

methods.name: processStreamWithRateLimit
methods.description: Processes a readable stream with rate limiting, chunk handling, and abort support.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Utility function to pause execution for a specified duration.

methods.name: getVoices
methods.description: Retrieves available voices for specified TTS provider using stored credentials.
